Thanks to the excellent judgment
of Squad Leader Onyx, I was promoted
to guarding the watchtower.

rows.label: tlk70000009_02_msg0002
rows.name:
It's a great view, isn't it? You can
see across the whole capital.

rows.label: tlk70000009_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Of course I can see the gate too...
and my older brother.

rows.label: tlk70000009_02_msg0005
rows.name:
No, that's already over. I'll protect
Iira in my own way.
